Use case: precise-object-edit. Single native >=1024 square transparent RGBA game sprite. Image 1 exact target ice sword girl, change ONLY lower limbs below skirt. Image 2 is same character leg proportion/support guide, not to copy upper pose. Image 3 approved finish. Preserve target head/hair/crown position, torso lean, costume, both arms and shoulder-sleeve-elbow-hand links, sword in RIGHT near hand, blue talisman in LEFT far hand. Feet long axes straight EAST screen RIGHT, no outward splay, no V feet. Anatomical far LEFT leg is support this half, anatomical near RIGHT leg swings lifted in foreground. Boot sole contact implied at roughly95% canvas height, no drawn floor/shadow. Do not translate/resize whole figure; independent native leg drawing, no image duplication, mirror, interpolation, warp, collage or text.
The far LEFT rear leg must reach down and back toward screen LEFT, left REAR boot forefoot pressed onto floor at about43% canvas width and95% height, heel gently raised. Keep near RIGHT front knee forward and its boot clearly lifted at leasthalf boot-height above floor. Do NOT put front right boot down. FIRST rear-push left support pose.
